theme.title: Kareem and the Big O
theme.subtitle: Milwaukee, 1970–71
theme.recap: In only its third season Milwaukee won 66 games and a title behind Lew Alcindor and Oscar Robertson.

questions.prompt: In only their third season, how many games did the 1970–71 Bucks win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Milwaukee posted a 66–16 record in only its third year of existence

questions.prompt: Lew Alcindor led the NBA in scoring in 1970–71. What was his average?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In only his second professional season, Lew Alcindor led the league in scoring at 31.7 ppg

questions.prompt: The 1970–71 Bucks set what was then the NBA's longest winning streak. How many games?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This season included a 20-game winning streak, the NBA's longest at the time, and still ranked fifth all-time

questions.prompt: In his first Bucks season, how many assists per game did Oscar Robertson average?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Robertson ranked third in the league in assists at 8.3 apg and was the Bucks' No. 2 scorer at 19.4 ppg.

questions.prompt: How old was Kareem Abdul-Jabbar when he retired after the 1989 Finals?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
